products.title: Humdinger
products.body_html:
Our most popular blend, balance, acidity and versatile brewing.

Origin: Brazil + Colombia

Farm: Cerrado Mineiro + Gaitania, Planadas municipality

Process method: Natural + Washed

Varietal: multiple varietals

Tasting notes: Chocolate, malt, biscuit.

Brew: Espresso, stovetop.

Recommended Recipe: Espresso: 1:1.85 grams-in-to-grams-out over 30 seconds, if it tastes sour, run the shot for longer. If washed out or bitter shorten then shot until you find a flavour profile you enjoy

products.title: Bogota Baby
products.body_html:
Colombia has been such a go-to Single. We are proud of the flavours that translate in this. That body of a Colombian with caramels and sugars that are best enjoyed black or with less milk.

Origin: Colombia

Farm: Gaitania, Planadas municipality

Process method: Fully Washed

Varietal: Caturra, Typica

Score: +86

Tasting notes: Clean, stone fruit, balanced acidity

Brew: Espresso, French press, Stovetop, Cold Brew

Recipe:

Espresso: 1:1.85 grams-in-to-grams-out over 30 seconds. For a short black, we suggest 1:1 ratio for a sweeter smoother double ristretto.

Plunger: we recommend pre heating vessel with hot water, then weighing grams in (we suggest starting with 15g) and steeping for 4min with one agitation in the beginning. Then press and pour out all contents into another vessel. Adjust grams as to your liking.

products.title: Sugarman
products.body_html:
A dual roast single origin that is easier to think of as a blend. Good for someone that likes to try what's new. Presently it is presenting moderate acidity and yellow fruit flavours with chocolate finish.

Origin: Brazil

Farm: Sucuri

Process method: Natural

Varietal: Yellow Catuai

Tasting notes: Rose, apricot, ripe fruit, floral, milk chocolate finish.

Brew: Stovetop, espresso, French press

Recommended Recipe: Espresso: 1:1.85 grams-in-to-grams-out over 30 seconds. If it tastes sour, run the shot for longer. If washed out or bitter shorten then shot until you find a flavour profile you enjoy

products.title: Decaf
products.body_html:
Hotly contested as the best decaf people can find. We can't take credit for the exceptional quality of the green coffee but our air roasting definitely takes this to new heights. Leaving people wondering if it is decaf.

Origin: Multiple origins

Process method: Swiss Water

Varietal: multiple varietals

Tasting notes: Chocolate, cacao, good body and balance

Brew: Espresso, French press, Stovetop

Swiss water method only uses water, temperature and time to gently remove the caffeine, while preserving all the coffee’s original characteristics. Combined with our one of a kind air roasting, it’s an amazing combo.

products.title: Single Origin
products.body_html:
Our single origin is a seasonal roast. We approach this as an omniroast, going flexibility in brewing. Centred around a a medium roast profile as an espresso, but being able to be enjoyed as a plunger, stove top and batch brew.

Origin: Brazil

Process method: Natural

Varietal: Yellow Catuai

products.title: Filter of the Month
products.body_html: This is a seasonal filter that is selected from only our top end suppliers and roasted to perfection. We aim to allow the coffee to best present its stand out qualities. This coffee is best as a V60 or batch brew.
